response.reason: The softmax weights are quantized to float16 (eps ~4.9e-4 relative) before the weighted sum over V, while the input construction (center=0.9) deliberately shrinks the output norm to ~10% of p@v, so the fp16-induced error (~1e-4..1e-3 absolute against ||y||≈0.05) yields relative error E well above the 1e-3 budget.
